Koshari

Egypt · North Africa

Cairo's unofficial national dish layers humble pantry staples — lentils, rice, macaroni and chickpeas — under a tangy tomato sauce spiked with cumin and garlic vinegar, then crowned with crisp fried onions.

Ingredients

Servings 4
  • 1 cup brown lentils
  • 1 cup short-grain rice
  • 1 cup small macaroni
  • 1 can chickpeas
  • 4 ripe tomatoes, crushed
  • 2 tsp ground cumin
  • 4 cloves garlic
  • 2 onions, thinly sliced

Instructions

Four steps to layered koshari
  1. Cook the grains Boil lentils until just tender. Cook rice and macaroni separately and drain.
  2. Fry the onions Fry sliced onions in oil until deep golden and crisp; drain on paper.
  3. Spiced tomato sauce Sauté garlic and cumin, add crushed tomatoes and a splash of vinegar; simmer 15 minutes.
  4. Assemble Layer rice, lentils, pasta and chickpeas; top with sauce and the crispy onions.
